recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Do not add redundant core Slot eligibility elements or prose for FHIR-32295; Slot-specific constraints should use local extensions unless a future PA decision changes core Slot.
issue_request: FHIR-32295 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and asked for Slot eligibility or constraint support. The approved resolution chose HealthcareService eligibility/characteristic chained search through Slot.serviceType rather than adding eligibility fields directly to Slot.
initial_application: FHIR-22687 changed Slot.serviceType to CodeableReference(HealthcareService) and added Slot-service-type-reference; FHIR-32295 then added HealthcareService-eligibility. HealthcareService-characteristic was already present.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps Slot and HealthcareService active PA resources. PA minutes confirm the May 2022 handling and September 2022 vote. Later FHIR-39127 found the FHIR-32295 approach did not satisfy all Slot-specific constraints but was Resolved - No Change with local Slot extension guidance, while FHIR-41782 later expanded HealthcareService.eligibility.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current source already contains Slot.serviceType.reference, Slot-service-type-reference, HealthcareService-eligibility, and HealthcareService-characteristic, which together satisfy the published FHIR-32295 resolution.
